lede: A runner runs agents on a person's machine, with its git and its claude login. The code stays there: Thulu only sees the folders the runner reports and what each run returns.

empty.title: No machines yet
empty.body: Add one to create projects from a folder on it.

row.no_folders: No allowed folders: run thulu runner allow on that machine.
row.not_reported: It hasn't reported its folders yet: start it with thulu runner run.
row.local_tools_selected_none: Local tools: selected, with nothing selected yet.
row.local_tools_all: Local tools: every MCP the machine has, claude.ai connectors included.
row.local_tools_hint: Set on the machine: thulu runner config local-tools.
row.bypass_off: A Claude Code policy on the machine turns off bypass mode: runs may use only what allowed_tools lists.
row.bypass_off_empty: A Claude Code policy on the machine turns off bypass mode and allowed_tools is empty: runs cannot edit files or run commands.

setup.register_detail: The token works once and expires in {minutes} min.
setup.allow_title: Allow the folders with your code
setup.allow_detail: Change ~/code for your folder. The runner only touches repositories inside it.
setup.start_detail: As a service it starts with the session; thulu runner run keeps it in the terminal.
setup.waiting: Waiting for the machine to connect…

confirm.title: Revoke {name}?
confirm.message: Its projects stop running until you move them to another machine, and runs with AI-engine profiles on it are refused until you edit those profiles. To use it again, register it with a new token.

mix.machines: A task runs on one machine, and these projects are on {machines}. Split it into one task per machine.
